$sources: ACI 318-19 Chapter 17 (Anchoring to Concrete), Sec 17.1-17.10 (alpha 9 track C12); the values the 2019 edition keeps from the default pack's Appendix K are the parent's, cited here by their Chapter 17 sections

sources.scope: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.1: cast-in and post-installed (expansion, screw, undercut, adhesive) anchors in concrete; shear lugs (Sec 17.11) are not covered
sources.general: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.2.1-17.2.3 and 17.4: elastic analysis of the group; required strength from the factored load combinations of Chapter 5
sources.seismic: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.10: Seismic Design Categories C to F; the concrete-governed strengths × 0.75 (Sec 17.10.5.4) unless the ductile steel, yielding attachment or Ωo route of Sec 17.10.5.3 applies; the default pack's 0.4 reduced-strength and 0.5 stud-wall options kept as SAEngine practice (not ACI 318-19 options)
sources.concreteStrengthMax: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.3.1: f'c at most 69 MPa (10 000 psi) cast-in and 55 MPa (8 000 psi) post-installed in the calculations
sources.lightweight: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.2.4: λa = 1.0 λ cast-in and concrete failure of undercut anchors, 0.8 λ expansion and adhesive, 0.6 λ adhesive bond failure
sources.design: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.5.1-17.5.2, Tables 17.5.2: φNn >= Nua, φVn >= Vua for every failure mode
sources.applicability: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.3.2-17.3.3 and 17.6.2.2: the breakout method holds for da up to 100 mm (4 in) and hef up to 635 mm (25 in)
sources.phi: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.5.3, Tables 17.5.3(a)-(b): ductile steel 0.75 tension, 0.65 shear; brittle 0.65, 0.60; concrete Condition A / B cast-in 0.75 / 0.70, post-installed by category 0.75-0.45; anchor reinforcement 0.75
sources.steelTension: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.1.2, Eq 17.6.1.2: Nsa = Ase,N futa, futa <= 1.9 fya and 860 MPa (125 000 psi)
sources.breakoutTension: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.2.1-17.6.2.2, Eqs 17.6.2.1a-b, 17.6.2.2.1 and 17.6.2.2.3: Nb = kc λa √f'c hef^1.5, kc 10 cast-in, 7 post-installed (SI); 3.9 λa √f'c hef^(5/3) for 280 <= hef <= 635 mm
sources.narrowTension: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.2.1.2: within 1.5 hef of three or more edges, hef taken as the larger of ca,max/1.5 and s/3
sources.crackingTension: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.2.5: uncracked ψc,N 1.25 cast-in, 1.4 post-installed (kc 7)
sources.splitting: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.2.6, Eqs 17.6.2.6.1a-b: ψcp,N of post-installed anchors in uncracked concrete without supplementary reinforcement
sources.anchorReinforcement: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.5.2.1 (a)-(b): anchor reinforcement developed on both sides of the breakout surface, φ 0.75
sources.pullout: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.3, Eqs 17.6.3.1, 17.6.3.2.2a-b: Np = 8 Abrg f'c headed, 0.9 f'c eh da hooked (3 da <= eh <= 4.5 da), ψc,P 1.4 uncracked
sources.sideFace: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.6.4, Eqs 17.6.4.1, 17.6.4.2: Nsb = 13 ca1 √Abrg λa √f'c where hef > 2.5 ca1
sources.steelShear: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.7.1, Eqs 17.7.1.2a-b: Vsa = Ase,V futa (studs), 0.6 Ase,V futa (bolts); × 0.8 with a grout pad (Sec 17.7.1.2.1)
sources.weldedShear: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.7.2.2.2, Eq 17.7.2.2.2: 0.66 for cast-in anchors welded to a steel attachment, with the bound 3.7 of Eq 17.7.2.2.1b
sources.narrowShear: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.7.2.1.2: with three or more edges, ca1 taken as the largest of ca2/1.5, ha/1.5 and s/3
sources.crackingShear: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.7.2.5: ψc,V 1.4 uncracked; cracked 1.0 without, 1.2 with an edge bar No. 13 or larger, 1.4 with the edge bar enclosed by stirrups at 100 mm or less
sources.pryout: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.7.3, Eqs 17.7.3.1a-b: Vcp = kcp Ncp, kcp 1.0 for hef < 65 mm, 2.0 otherwise
sources.interaction: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.8: full strength in one direction where the other ratio is at most 0.2; otherwise Nua/φNn + Vua/φVn <= 1.2
sources.spacing: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.9.2: spacing at least 4 da untorqued cast-in, 6 da torqued and post-installed; edge distances as cover (cast-in untorqued), 6 da torqued, 6, 8, 10 da post-installed (undercut, torque-controlled, displacement-controlled)
sources.postInstalledDepth: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.9.3: hef of expansion, screw and undercut anchors at most 2/3 of the member thickness and the thickness less 100 mm
sources.criticalEdge: ACI 318-19 Sec 17.9.5: cac 2.5 hef undercut, 4 hef torque-controlled and displacement-controlled (without product tests)
sources.anchorRods: AISC 360-22 Sec J9 and ACI 318-19 Chapter 17: anchor rods resist the net tension of the column base
sources.momentBase: SAEngine practice (ACI 318-19 Chapter 17 asks the rod tension from the base moment but gives no method): the rod tension by the plate's lever arm
sources.estimates: SAEngine practice, not a code value: the nut bearing area and thread pitch used when the anchor's own is not entered
